performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

# Native class delegation and reasoning ownership

The full active goal covers all logic issues and PRs, not this increment alone. Issue 1803 remains open until actual production worlds, source-bound proofs, shared-store semantics and native class delegation/deletion qualify. Related open work includes joint producer/completion semantics (1748), authenticated external competency input (1749), complete prepared canonical proof admission (1770), and pipeline performance (1757). These are not discharged by a constructor or dependency update. Preserve prior merged evidence in the ghprsq Stage refs for PR1840 and PR1841.

Principles 4, 7, 17 and 18 govern the boundary. Preserve source identity, world/graph scope, local conflict support, complete native certificates and proof absence/presence. No local corpus producer, full make check/sync, host probes/caps, source filtering, weakened native admission or hook bypass is authorized. Synthetic checks and the explicit tiny witness producer are permitted; real corpus consumers require authenticated producer-selected receipts.

## Task 1: Consume cancellable recorded native preparation

Current state: committed as8ad7b3120 with normal hooks. Initial15 service controls and producer-independent strict Clippy passed; both tiny attestations were explicitly refreshed and reviewed. Final-pin combined controls, helpers and strict Clippy are running before PR publication.

Pin root and fuzz manifests/locks to the actual merged PurRDF head50172ad5534f409220f340ac0c6b3da581d577e0, including cancellation from1ce411424 and its subsequently merged capacity-proof metadata repair. Expose native recorded construction with explicit SchemaPreparationBudget and the same caller StopSignal through DlReasoner and its sole diagnostic mapping. Test completed proof replay, original typed preparation cancellation, later unknown/CallerStop receipts and selected preparation ceilings. Preserve existing unrecorded selection and do not add a non-firing signal or artificial deadline to callers. Run producer-independent synthetic tests, strict Clippy, normal hooks and scoped ghprsq integration. This increment advances rather than closes1803.

## Task 2: Checked source-bound native conflict support

Inspect and implement the upstream public proof-resolution seam rather than guessing source terms from private numeric NodeRef ordinals. Distinguish checked prepared-schema support from legacy clash-frame observation. Preserve rooted/local premise ownership and disconnected witness behavior. Independently check the precise native evidence against its original ontology and expose enough typed source resolution for GMEOW's proof ledger.

## Task 3: Shared native store and monotone updates

Implement or consume the actual borrowed/shared store and append/delta seam in the native reasoning owner. Avoid re-parsing or copying each whole world on every joint round. Preserve frozen-schema frontier checks, positive fact/equality growth, proof-context invalidation, completed-read requirements, selected budgets/stops and exact current source identity. Compare cold/warm/unchanged/delta behavior with fresh native construction using synthetic controls and authenticated production inputs when available.

## Task 4: Delegate and delete the inferior class engine

Wire the joint production class family through the qualified native implementation, preserve complete native decisions/refusals/coverage and rooted supported conflict heads, and remove obsolete class decision alternatives only after equivalence and extended capability tests pass. Classical global inconsistency must never become a false local clash for every individual. Retain the named disconnected-membership, singleton-nominal, late-equality and closure-frontier controls. Run the exact authenticated production worlds; never filter source to obtain a verdict or treat an old source receipt as the new head.

## Task 5: Continue the full logic queue through merge

Refresh full issue bodies/comments and PR review surfaces, not title-only triage. Integrate CodeRabbit findings where available; distinguish pending hosted qualification from a pass. Use only ghprsq for final integrations, archive meaningful Stage evidence and clean up only owned branches/worktrees. Continue 1748/1749/1770/1757 and remaining logic issues to their actual acceptance criteria; do not redefine the goal around the work already merged.

Recorded DL callers can retain one caller-owned native stop signal through canonical input identity, ontology preparation and decision search while selecting the native preparation budget explicitly. DlReasoner forwards both to the native owner through the existing diagnostic mapping, preserving complete certificates/proofs and original typed cancellation or source refusals. Stopped decisions remain unknown with native CallerStop receipts.

Root/fuzz manifests and all31 native package identities in each lock select merged PurRDF50172ad55. That includes the cancellation implementation and the subsequently merged capacity-proof requalification. No new dependency, compatibility layer, dataset copy, source filtering, timer, default ceiling or fallback is added. Existing unrecorded selection remains explicit; no non-firing signal is invented for callers that selected no cancellation capability.

Three new adapter controls exercise completed replay plus later stop, source-independent typed cancellation diagnostics, and exact native budget certificate/proof retention. The existing invalid-role diagnostic/ledger control also covers the controlled constructor. The explicit tiny witness producer verifies closure determinism and corroborated/refuted-in-standpoint outcomes before refreshing complete unredacted bytes; the reviewed records differ only in identity strings.

The attempted make fuzz-substrate-check was interrupted because it routes through a controller that can build/fingerprint a local producer, outside this session's authority. It is not counted as a pass. The incident and exact log remain in validation.md.

Principles 4, 7, 17 and 18: preserve one native semantic owner, source-bound evidence and honest operational incompleteness. This increment exposes the native capability but does not claim joint class-engine delegation, rooted reachability support, shared-store/delta, production-world qualification or removal of the old engine.
